casualtiestogether_mainmenu_mp_button_to: Enable Multiplayer Mod. (This restarts the game!)
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_sv_cheats: Unlock all console commands on server.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_Teams:
Players with same color are considered a team.
Player Scatter Distance works only for your team.
PVP only works against other teams.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_XPGainMulti: XP Gain multiplier, for INT, STR, RES together
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_LateJoinSpe: Late joined players will instantly die and put into spectator mode.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_NoInventory: Can steal stuff from other players even if they're conscious.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_StragglerRa:
Start the radiation line when this percentage of living players reaches the end of the layer, pressuring those left behind.
0 still requires at least one arrival; 100 disables this rule.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ScatterPuni:
Distance in meters used to check whether a player is separated from the group. Players without enough nearby companions, as defined by ScatterMinGroupSize, receive radiation damage.
0 or any value of 449 or higher disables this rule.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ScatterMinG:
Percentage of living players who must be nearby to avoid the separation penalty, including yourself. The required player count is rounded up.
0 disables the separation penalty.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AllowClient:
Deprecated, you should just give them "adminpriv"
This rule only allows for executing client-side commands, like "tp"
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AlwaysAllow: Allow picking up and carrying conscious and standing players.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_OnlyProximi: Text chat can only be heard within radius of "ProximityHearDistance".
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SavePlayerI: Keep a disconnected player's items for their return. When disabled, players drop their items on disconnect.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SavePlayerP: Disconnected player will spawn at their last position when rejoined.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_Permadeath: Disable revival through layer transitions and trader recruitment. Cheat commands are not affected.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ReviveOnNex: Respawn all dead players after layer transition.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ReviveFromT: Ability to "Recruit" traders, to respawn one random player.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_TrackPlayer: Show player death announcements in chat, death markers and the living player count. Disable this rule to hide that information.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PLAYER_COUN: Maximum number of players who can be connected to the server at once.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ShowPlayerD: Show direction indicators to help you find other players.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_EnableNamet: Show name tags next to other players' characters.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_EnableStatu: Show status icons next to characters to help you assess your companions' condition.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_UnchippedHi: Hide other players' name tags when your character has no chip implant.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_EnableChatb: Enable the multiplayer text chat window.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_UnchippedPr: Characters without a chip implant can only receive text messages from players within ProximityHearDistance.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_UnchippedIs: Let each player choose whether to have a chip implant. When disabled, all players use the host's chip setting.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_LayerFinish:
Percentage of living players who must reach the end to enter the next layer. The required player count is rounded up.
0 = at least one player, 50 = half, 100 = all living players, 101 = disable layer transitions.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_EnableSleep: Allow characters to sleep. When disabled, characters who are not in critical condition recover energy automatically, reducing the need for sleep.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SpeechImpai: Let speech impairments affect typing and outgoing text messages, distorting words or making them harder to express.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_HearingLoss: Let hearing loss, brain damage and similar conditions distort or obscure received text messages.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_MindwipeDis:
Restrict communication after a mind wipe.
The actual text and voice distortions also depend on the corresponding speech and hearing rules.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_DeadTextcha: Allow living and dead players to communicate through text chat. Always allowed in the tutorial.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_DeadVoicech: Allow living and dead players to communicate through voice chat. Always allowed in the tutorial.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_RespawnKeep: When dead players revive during a layer transition, keep the items still on their bodies that have not been taken or destroyed.
Keep a character's existing skills when revived. When disabled, their skills are reset.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AllowSpecta: Allow spectators to use a free camera instead of always following another player.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AllowPush: Allow pushing other players through the player interaction menu or its key binding.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PiggybackMa: Limit the number of players stacked in a piggyback chain. Set to 0 to disable climbing onto another player's back.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PiggybackWe:
Multiplier applied to a carried player's total weight when adding it to the carrier's load, including their items and any players they carry.
0 = no added weight, 1 = actual weight.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SpectateWhi: Allow players who are unconscious but still alive to enter spectator mode.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_EnableMP3Sy: Synchronize MP3 players as shared sound sources in the game world, so nearby players hear the same music.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_VoicechatQu:
Set the maximum voice chat sample rate:
0 = 8 kHz, 1 = 12 kHz, 2 = 16 kHz, 3 = 24 kHz, 4 = 48 kHz.
Higher settings allow better audio quality and may increase bandwidth and processing costs.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_VoicechatEn: Allow players to use their microphones for voice chat.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ProximityHe: Hearing distance for proximity voice chat, in meters. Also limits text messages when proximity text chat rules are enabled.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_CharacterYa: Share automatic character speech caused by pain, emotions and similar reactions with other players.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PVPCombatDi: Allow combat between players to cause dismemberment, disfigurement and other severe injuries. Corpses can still be dismembered when disabled.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PVPMoodDebu: Strength of the mood penalty for attacking other players. Some attacks also increase psychological trauma. Set to 0 to remove this penalty.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_PVPDamageMu: Damage multiplier for combat between players. 1 is the default strength.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_LateJoinAll: Allow other players to join the server after the run has started.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AmputateHea: Allow amputating other players' healthy limbs.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AdditionalH:
Strength of the extra physical recovery provided by multiplayer, affecting limb healing, hearing, blood recovery and similar processes.
0 removes this extra recovery; it does not disable all natural healing.

Accelerate blood loss, brain damage from oxygen deprivation and similar deterioration when a character is dying (red circle) and lacks nearby help. Also affects splint durability loss.
0 removes this extra acceleration.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SelfharmWit: Strength of the mood penalty for nearby players who witness a companion harming themselves. The range and severity depend on the act.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AutoContinu: Start a run automatically once the minimum player count is reached, and enter the next layer automatically once its requirements are met. Mainly for dedicated servers.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AutoMinPlrs: Minimum number of connected players needed to start a run automatically when AutoContinue is enabled.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AutoExitWhe: On an automatically managed dedicated server, return to the main menu to wait for the next run when all players have died.
On an automatically managed dedicated server, return to the main menu when all players have disconnected.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_ConsentForF: Ask for confirmation before feeding or using items on a conscious player. Unconscious players do not need to confirm.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_LayerFinish: Try to preserve each player's horizontal position relative to the group when entering the next layer. Does not apply to initial or late-join spawns.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_RadlineExtr: Deal additional damage to characters far behind the radiation line or already unconscious, eliminating stragglers faster.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SpeechImpai: Let speech impairments distort a character's outgoing voice chat.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_HearingLoss: Let a character's hearing loss affect received voice chat, for example by making it quieter or muffled.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SleepingMut: Mute voice chat while a character is sleeping as well. Ordinary unconsciousness always mutes voice chat, regardless of this setting.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_MinigameMax: Maximum number of players who can participate in the same minigame session at once.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_SpawnOnPlay: When joining a run in progress, prefer spawning next to a living companion. Use the normal spawn location if no suitable player is available.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_AdditionalB:
Provide extra brain recovery when help is possible, the air is breathable and the brain is not yet critically damaged. Its effectiveness depends on food, water and the degree of brain damage.
0 removes this extra recovery.
casualtiestogether_rule_desc_LastStandAl: Allow the game's Last Stand mechanic, giving characters a final chance to survive when near death.
casualtiestogether_setting_chatpreview_d: Preview speech impaired distortions before sending your chat message.
casualtiestogether_setting_chatpreviewon: Move chat input preview box to the side.
casualtiestogether_setting_vcattenuation: How much to temporarily silence background music when someone is speaking.
